deleteChapterDownload.message:
You are about to remove "{{title}}", which will delete downloaded chapter files.
You can also choose to just hide it from the list if you want to keep the files for offline reading.

How should we proceed?

finalConfirmation.title: Are you absolutely certain?
finalConfirmation.message:
This will be your last chance to back out before the chapter files are permanently deleted. File deletion cannot be undone, but you can always re-download the chapter if you change your mind.

Just a reminder, you are deleting chapter: {{title}}

clearCoverCache.title: Clear all cached covers?
clearCoverCache.message:
This will delete {{count}} cached images ({{size}}).

Cover images will be re-downloaded as needed when browsing. This may temporarily slow down performance.

cleanMetadataCache.title: Clean up metadata cache?
cleanMetadataCache.message:
This will remove browsing cache older than 90 days.

Favorited manga and manga with downloads will not be affected.

Estimated to remove: {{count}} manga

clearAllMetadata.title: Clear all metadata cache?
clearAllMetadata.message:
This will remove ALL browsing cache ({{count}} manga).

Only favorited manga and manga with downloads will be kept.

This action cannot be undone.

deleteOldLogs.title: Cleanup old logs?
deleteOldLogs.message: This will permanently delete all log files older than {{days}} days. This action cannot be undone.

clearAllLogs.title: Clear all logs?
clearAllLogs.message: This will permanently delete all log files. This action cannot be undone.

clearAllOverrides.title: Clear all custom reading settings?
clearAllOverrides.message: You have custom settings for {{count}} manga. They'll all be reset to your global defaults. You can't undo this!

System Info:
• Total RAM: {{totalRAM}} GB
• Recommended maximum: {{recommended}} MB (10% of system RAM)
